'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 16–17 April 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 16–17 April 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
